# Tapir commands: Issue Management Commands

The 11 commands of this group, with their parameters, results and examples. Every group and how a command is sent: [commands.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands.md).

## Issue Management Commands

### CreateIssue

Creates a new issue.

Group: Issue Management Commands. Added in Tapir 1.0.2. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#CreateIssue

Parameters:

- `name` (string, required): The name of the issue.
- `parentIssueId` (IssueId)
- `tagText` (string): Tag text of the issue, optional.

Returns:

- `issueId` (IssueId, required)

Grasshopper: `CreateIssueComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/CreateIssue.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/CreateIssue.py): Creates an issue with a tag text using CreateIssue, then deletes it again.

### DeleteIssue

Deletes the specified issue. With dryRun true nothing is deleted and no undo step is created: the response has dryRun set to true, and wouldDelete when the issue exists.

Group: Issue Management Commands. Added in Tapir 1.0.2. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#DeleteIssue

Parameters:

- `issueId` (IssueId, required)
- `acceptAllElements` (boolean): Accept all creation/deletion/modification of the deleted issue. By default false.
- `dryRun` (DryRun)

Returns:

- `dryRun` (DryRunFlag)
- `success` (boolean, required)
- `error` (Error)
- `wouldDelete` (boolean (true))

Grasshopper: `DeleteIssueComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/DeleteIssue.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/DeleteIssue.py): Creates an issue and deletes it with DeleteIssue.

### GetIssues

Retrieves information about existing issues.

Group: Issue Management Commands. Added in Tapir 1.0.2. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetIssues

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `issues` (array of object, required): A list of existing issues.
  - `issueId` (IssueId, required)
  - `name` (string, required): Issue name
  - `parentIssueId` (IssueId, required)
  - `creaTime` (integer, required): Issue creation time
  - `modiTime` (integer, required): Issue modification time
  - `tagText` (string, required): Issue tag text - labels
  - `tagTextElementId` (ElementId, required)
  - `isTagTextElemVisible` (boolean, required): The visibility of the attached tag text element

Grasshopper: `GetAllIssuesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/GetIssues.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/GetIssues.py): Lists the issues of the project with GetIssues.

### ExportIssuesToBCF

Exports specified issues to a BCF file. With overwrite false it refuses to replace an existing file.

Group: Issue Management Commands. Added in Tapir 1.0.6. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ExportIssuesToBCF

Parameters:

- `issues` (Issues): Leave it empty to export all issues.
- `exportPath` (string, required): The os path to the bcf file, including it's name. An existing file is overwritten, unless overwrite is false.
- `overwrite` (boolean): Optional, true by default. false refuses to export when a file already exists at exportPath, and writes nothing.
- `useExternalId` (boolean, required): Use external IFC ID or Archicad IFC ID as referenced in BCF topics.
- `alignBySurveyPoint` (boolean, required): Align BCF views by Archicad Survey Point or Archicad Project Origin.


Grasshopper: `ExportIssuesToBCFComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/ExportIssuesToBCF.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/ExportIssuesToBCF.py): Exports every issue of the project to a BCF file in the temporary folder with ExportIssuesToBCF. Leaving out the issues parameter, as here, exports every issue of the project.

### ImportIssuesFromBCF

Imports issues from the specified BCF file.

Group: Issue Management Commands. Added in Tapir 1.0.6. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ImportIssuesFromBCF

Parameters:

- `importPath` (string, required): The os path to the bcf file, including it's name.
- `alignBySurveyPoint` (boolean, required): Align BCF views by Archicad Survey Point or Archicad Project Origin.


Grasshopper: `ImportIssuesFromBCFComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/ImportIssuesFromBCF.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/ImportIssuesFromBCF.py): Exports a new issue to a temporary BCF file, deletes it, then imports it back with ImportIssuesFromBCF. Leaves the imported issue in the project.

### ImportMarkupsFromPDF

Imports the markups of the specified PDF file as issues, like Issue Manager > Import PDF markups, without any dialog and without opening the Issue Manager palette, and reports the issues it created. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Issue Management Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ImportMarkupsFromPDF

Parameters:

- `pdfFilePath` (string, required): The os path to the PDF file with the markups, including it's name.

Returns:

- `executionResult` (ExecutionResult, required)
- `issues` (Issues, required): The issues the import created. Empty when the import failed.

Grasshopper: `ImportMarkupsFromPDFComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/ImportMarkupsFromPDF.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/IssueManagement/ImportMarkupsFromPDF.py): Imports the markups of a PDF file as issues with ImportMarkupsFromPDF, like Issue Manager > Import PDF markups. Needs a PDF with markups, here markups.pdf in the home folder. Creates one issue per markup. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

## Shared schema definitions

Types that parameters and results refer to by name.

### Elements

array of ElementIdArrayItem: A list of elements.

### ElementIdArrayItem

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)

### ElementId

object: The identifier of an element.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### Guid

string: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

### Error

object: The details of an error.
- `code` (integer, required): The code of the error.
- `message` (string, required): The error message.

### SuccessfulExecutionResult

object: The result of a successful execution.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)

### FailedExecutionResult

object: The result of a failed execution.
- `success` (boolean (false), required)
- `error` (Error, required)

### ExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of the execution.

### DryRun

boolean: If true, the command makes all the checks of a real run and resolves the same targets, with the same errors, but changes nothing in the project and creates no undo step. The response is that of a real run with "dryRun": true added, and says for each target what the real run would do. Default is false.

### DryRunFlag

boolean (true): Present, and true, only in the response of a dry run (the dryRun input was true): nothing was changed in the project.

### IssueId

object: The identifier of an issue.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### IssueIdArrayItem

object
- `issueId` (IssueId, required)

### Issues

array of IssueIdArrayItem: A list of Issues.

### IssueElementType

string ("Creation", "Highlight", "Deletion", "Modification"): The attachment type of an element component of an issue.

### IssueCommentStatus

string ("Error", "Warning", "Info", "Unknown"): The status of an issue comment.
